manifest.name: Kin Casino
manifest.purpose: 13 casino games for play chips: Solo vs the house is free on screen. Play with your Kin, or host friends at a table (uses Kindroid credits). Nothing to buy.

actions.name: wake
actions.description: Open Kin Casino and see how the casino table stands: the game, chips and whose turn it is. Use when the person wants to play casino games or asks how the table is going.

works: Its screen opens here in your browser.
Its runs happen on this PC for free (no Kindroid Apps credits).
shim: Saving and loading (files) are kept on this PC.
Your Kin is asked through Kindroid's API with your own key (normal Kin messages, not Apps credits).
Tables with other people go through the relay instead of Kindroid's inbound addresses.

manifest.name: Kin Hold'em
manifest.purpose: Texas Hold'em for play chips. Free Solo vs computer players runs on screen with no credits. Or host a table for up to 5 people, or seat your Kins (uses Kindroid credits).

actions.name: wake
actions.description: Open Kin Hold'em and see how the poker table stands: hands, chips and whose turn it is. Use when the person wants to play poker or asks how the game is going.

shim: Saving and loading (files) are kept on this PC.

manifest.name: Kin Games: Table & Arcade
manifest.purpose: 23 table, arcade, dice and classic games (air hockey, pool, bowling, Ludo, Yacht, Mancala). Play free in Solo against the computer, or play your Kin (uses Kindroid credits). It remembers who won.

actions.name: kin_games_record
actions.description: Use when the person asks how many games you have won or lost against them in Kin Games: Table & Arcade (its table, arcade, dice and classic games).

actions.name: game_over
actions.description: Records a game finished on the Kin Games screen and tells the Kin how it went.
